name: Case law: United States, the Louisiana Supreme Court and 4 other courts of Louisiana
label: United States case law (the Louisiana Supreme Court and 4 other courts of Louisiana)
coverage: 184460 published opinions with text, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 57 citations of the US Code linked to united-states/federal/usc.
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. Commits before 1970 are dated 1970-01-01, a second apart; In-force holds the real day. Read from So.2d, La., So.3d, La. Ann., So., Rob., Mart. (n.s.), Mart. (o.s.), Mann. Unrep. Cas., F. Cas., Wheel. Cr. Cas.. The head matter (syllabi, headnotes, counsel) is left out: it is the publisher's text, not the court's. Every decision is a published opinion (precedential_status: published); CAP records no other status. CAP is a closed archive (its last volumes are of 2018-2020): no nightly runner appends to this repo. The US Code record holds only some titles, so most statute citations are not linked.
update: none: the Caselaw Access Project is a static archive, so no nightly runner is registered

source.publisher: Caselaw Access Project (Harvard Law School Library)
